name: PSA-MoM
description: Meeting minutes (MoM) and action tracking for SPE Engineering and PMO, PSA Antwerp. Single self-contained HTML file; data = files in a synced SharePoint library folder.
build: python build.py  ->  release/PSA-MoM-v<version>.html, release/PSA-MoM-viewer.html, build/combined.js; runs test.js and smoke.js

sources.src/core.js: pure logic (CSV, project list, people, config, meeting .md, action registers, IDs, merge, exports, MoM renderers)
sources.src/app.js: editor UI + File System Access storage, merge-on-save, locks, conflict copies
sources.src/style.css: look & feel (from the 1-op-1 Manager) + MoM print layout

files._bron/projecten.csv: read-only copy of the SharePoint list 'Project budgets & SNOW ref' (Power Automate or manual export); internal (field_1..) or display column names; , or ; ; BOM optional
files.vergaderingen/YYYY/.<file>.md.lock: advisory soft lock JSON {gebruiker,naam,sinds,ververst}; ignored after 2 h
action register (source of truth for actions): id;gi_code;vergadering;datum_geidentificeerd;topic(<type>:<nr>);actie;eigenaar;deadline;prioriteit;status;afgesloten_op;afsluiting;verloop( || );aangemaakt_door;gewijzigd_door;gewijzigd_op
files._export/vergaderingen.csv, minuten.csv,: derived, rebuilt by the editor; line breaks as ⏎; read by the viewer
files._backup/: <datum>_<code>/<pad> = copy before first write per day; pre-migratie-vX/; conflicten/

csv: UTF-8 with BOM, separator ;, every field quoted, CRLF, ISO dates (yyyy-mm-dd), stamps yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm:ss local time
